precondition: No account fields, password, cookies, screenshots, page text, or raw accessibility tree are read or retained.
steps: Launch the device Browser directly with the standard view-data action and the public sign-in URL.
Wait 12 seconds, then inspect only generic accessibility component counts and boolean markers.
Observe two Navigation components, one Web component, Browser-chrome marker true, Cloudflare-resource marker true, and no visible verification-marker match.
result: The system Browser launch and Web-page load passed. This does not prove Cloudflare completion or account authentication: Browser page DOM is opaque to the accessibility tree and its cookie jar is independent from ArkWeb.
nextn_comparison: NextN uses NextE's same controller-attached UA transformation and enables first- and third-party ArkWeb cookies before the blank-src controller loads the login URL. ArkWeb session capture remains first-party and does not import Browser cookies.
cleanup: All temporary device and host accessibility-layout files were removed after extracting the generic evidence.
